mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dot identifies an interior point of the straight function graph at its x-intercept. Right image: The dot includes the terminal x-intercept (1, 0) in the function graph.
Rationales: The feature identifies a specific point on the interior of the continuing graph in the left image and marks an endpoint included in the plotted branch in the right image. The filled yellow-orange dot on the line near its x-intercept. The filled blue dot at (1, 0), where the trace ends on the right.
